items.source: Creates GenericJackson2JsonRedisSerializer initialized with an ObjectMapper configured for default typing using the given name along with the given, required Jackson2ObjectReader and Jackson2ObjectWriter used to read/write Objects de/serialized as JSON.
items.translation: 创建并初始化一个 GenericJackson2JsonRedisSerializer，该序列化器使用给定的 name 配置为默认类型支持，并配合必需的 Jackson2ObjectReader 和 Jackson2ObjectWriter，用于对以 JSON 格式进行反/序列化的 Objects 进行读写操作。

items.source: Create a default Jackson2ObjectReader delegating to ObjectMapper.readValue(InputStream, JavaType).
items.translation: 创建一个默认的Jackson2ObjectReader，该对象委托给ObjectMapper.readValue(InputStream, JavaType)。

items.source: Creates a new Jackson2JsonRedisSerializer for the given target JavaType.
items.translation: 为给定的目标 JavaType 创建一个新的 Jackson2JsonRedisSerializer。

items.source: Setting a custom-configured ObjectMapper is one way to take further control of the JSON serialization process.
items.translation: 设置自定义配置的 `ObjectMapper` 是进一步控制 JSON 序列化过程的一种方式。

items.source: Serialization/Deserialization package for converting Object to (and from) binary data.
items.translation: 用于将对象转换为（以及从）二进制数据进行序列化和反序列化的包。

items.source: Uses of Jackson2ObjectReader in org.springframework.data.redis.serializer
items.translation: Jackson2ObjectReader 在 org.springframework.data.redis.serializer 包中的用途
